map.按旅行天数与出行类型推荐行李重量，附常见航司托运限额参考: Recommend luggage weight by trip length and travel type, with a reference table of common airline checked-baggage allowances
map.📖 查看「行李重量建议 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Luggage Weight Recommendation User Guide"
map.建议行李重量 = 基础重量 4.5 kg + 每天增量 × 旅行天数；每天增量按: Recommended luggage weight = base weight 4.5 kg + daily increment × trip days; the daily increment by travel type is: business 0.9, leisure 1.3, backpack 0.7, winter 1.8 kg; then adjust by gender and number of children traveling together; economy checked baggage is usually limited to 20 to 23 kg and carry-on to 7 to 10 kg, with overweight fees charged per airline rules.
map.✈️ 常见航司免费托运限额参考: ✈️ Free checked baggage allowance reference for common airlines
map.注：各航司政策不同，以上为常见参考，请以购票时航司规定为准。: Note: airline policies differ; the above is a common reference, please follow the airline rules at the time of purchase.
map.出行前按天数、类型（商务/休闲/户外）、性别、交通方式，预估随身+托运总重量区间: Before departure, estimate the total carry-on plus checked weight from days, type (business/leisure/outdoor), gender and transport mode, then compare against airline limits to judge whether overweight fees apply.
map.户外/滑雪等装备重，提前算好托运区间，避免现场被迫拆分或付超额费。: Outdoor and skiing gear is heavy, so calculate the checked range in advance to avoid being forced to split bags or pay excess fees on site.
map.多段交通（飞机+火车+自驾）时，以最严的托运限额为上限反推可带量。: With multi-leg transport (plane + train + self-drive), work backward from the strictest checked allowance to determine how much you can bring.
map.算例（女性 5 天休闲国内飞机）: Worked example (female, 5 days leisure, domestic flight)
map.休闲 5 天基准：托运 15-23kg、随身 7-10kg；性别微调女 -2kg: Leisure 5-day baseline: checked 15-23 kg, carry-on 7-10 kg; gender adjustment female -2 kg → checked 13-21 kg, carry-on 5-8 kg. Airline economy free checked allowance is typically 20-23 kg (varies domestic vs international), so keep checked at ≤23 kg to avoid fees; carry-on 5-8 kg fits cabin bag limits (most airlines 5-10 kg). Outdoor baselines are higher (checked 20-30 kg); if over 23 kg, buy excess allowance in advance or split into two bags.
map.以承运航司客票标注的免费额度（经济舱常见 20-23kg/件、廉价航 0-15k: Use the free allowance printed on your airline ticket (economy is commonly 20-23 kg per piece, low-cost 0-15 kg varies); this tool gives an empirical range, and the final answer is the baggage allowance of your flight. Excess is charged at airline rates, and buying allowance in advance is cheaper than on the day.
map.随身和托运怎么分？: How do I split carry-on and checked?
map.贵重/急用/液体超规走托运，证件/充电宝/常用药/换洗衣随身；登机箱限重+尺寸双: Put valuables, urgent items and over-limit liquids in checked baggage; keep documents, power banks, common medicine and a change of clothes on board. Cabin bags face both weight and size limits, and an oversized bag may be checked even when it is not overweight.
map.行李重量建议工具，按旅行天数、出行类型、性别等维度推荐行李总重量、托运与手提分配: The Luggage Weight Recommendation tool recommends total luggage weight and the checked / carry-on split by trip length, travel type and gender, and includes a reference table of common airline checked allowances.
